title: Importing Department Information from a CSV File

blocks.text: You can import up to 3,000 departments using a CSV file. If you want to add multiple users to an existing department or change the department for multiple users, you must use the user sample import CSV file.
To import new departments, or modify existing departments, using a CSV file:

blocks.item: Go to Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet & SaaS Users.
On the Departments tab, click Sample Import CSV file to download the department information template.
Enter your department information in the CSV file template.
Once you have the CSV file in the correct format, click Import.
In the Import Departments window, click Choose file, and navigate to the CSV file, then click Open.
After the CSV file is successfully imported, click Close.
